title: 字義辨析
point: 字義題四個選項常常長得很像，別只看中文意思。先看空格前後的搭配字，固定搭配會直接決定是哪個字。
formula: 先看空格前後的搭配字：動詞 + 受詞、形容詞 + 名詞

table.rule: constructive 修飾 feedback、criticism，意思是有幫助的；形近字 constructed 是「被建造的」，不修飾意見
restricted to + 對象，表示限定範圍；形近字 restrained 是「克制的」，不接範圍
extend 搭配 deadline、contract、trial period，表示時間拉長；expand 是擴大規模或範圍，不用在期限
meet 搭配 requirements、standards、deadline；reach 搭配 agreement、goal，不接 requirements
order 的固定動詞是 place；locate、position 雖然也有「放置」的意思，不跟 order 搭配
conduct 搭配 survey、inspection、interview；形近字 contact 是聯絡某人，不接 survey

examples: The director gave constructive comments on the hiring plan.
The marketing team conducted a customer survey on the new packaging.
story: Our office conducted a short survey on the new room booking system.
Most employees gave constructive feedback about its design.
However, access to the system is still restricted to managers.
The IT department agreed to extend the trial period until June.

drills.prompt: Can every employee use the booking system now?
drills.fix: restricted to managers 表示限定只有經理能用。

drills.prompt: Did IT make the trial period longer or shorter?
drills.fix: extend 搭配期限 the trial period，意思是延長。

drills.prompt: The purchasing team ___ an order for new chairs.
drills.fix: 動詞 + 受詞 order 的固定搭配是 place an order。
